newsitem.title: USA: DQE holders approve Alleheny Power merger.
newsitem.headline: DQE holders approve Alleheny Power merger.

text.p: DQE Inc, the parent organization of Duquesne Light Co, said on Thursday that its shareholders approved a proposed merger with Allegheny Power System Inc.
Later today, shareholders of Allegheny Power will vote on the deal, DQE said.
Completion of the merger, which will create the tenth largest investor-owned electric utility in the country, is expected to clear all regulatory agencies and take effect May 1998.

The formation of Allegheny Energy, which will be the name of the combined company, will result in a company with a combined equity value of $6.2 billion, serving two million customers in five states, DQE said.

The merger must be approved by several state and federal agencies including the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission and the Maryland Public Service Commission, the company said.
